column1: # The routes and what must hold on each replay: tools/check_routes.py (ctest oracles-routes, with ORACLES_ROM_DIR set).

# Enhanced on mGBA, subrosia-and-dungeon.route: on mGBA the route goes through the same rooms, but Link's position first differs at frame 3613, the frames the game's logic does not finish in falling elsewhere (a turnaround more, other walking and text frames after). Replayed to frame 3600, it shows on mGBA SameBoy's black (140 a frame on average, 5334 at most): the black above the ceiling of SameBoy's row (mean 100 against 97 over the route) is mGBA's game's, after it differs.
# subrosia-and-dungeon.route with the status bar drawn full width (--hud full): Subrosia's colours and a dungeon's, far and far 4:3.

# subrosia-and-dungeon.route with the transitions' diagonal (--continuous-diagonal): Link carried left and up into 1:58 and left and down into 1:57 in Subrosia, walls across holding him there (transitions.carried_frames, carry_withheld_frames), the game going elsewhere from 2719 on; his sprite steps back once (enhanced.link_backsteps_y), a pose of normal play at 8066, and his place jumps once more, a teleport inside 1:48 at 2998.
